name: Nine Tales Amber Ale
description: Hand-crafted with Pale and Crystal malts and distinctive hops, this full-bodied, malt-driven beer is characterised by its rich copper colour, toffee-caramel sweetness and nutty finish balanced against citrus hop notes

name: 150 Lashes Pale Ale
description: A refreshing pale ale full of flavour with citrus notes and crisp finish

name: Four Wives Pilsner
description: A traditional Czech-style pilsner with floral and spicy hop character

name: Pioneers' Collection English IPA
description: Richly hopped English IPA infused with a light touch of macadamia honey and matured in fine, hand selected single malt whisky barrels. A richly hopped, bold and exceptional beer of unrivalled quality that imparts subtle sweetness, notes of vanilla, and hints of soft spice.

name: Jack of Spades Porter
description: A dark and roasty porter with chocolate and coffee notes

name: Coopers Original Pale Ale
description: With fruity and floral characters, balanced with a crisp bitterness, Coopers Pale Ale has a compelling flavour which is perfect for every occasion

name: Coopers Sparkling Ale
description: A golden ale with a unique bottle fermented character and subtle sweetness

name: Coopers Dark Ale
description: A dark amber ale with rich malt complexity and smooth finish

name: Coopers Australian Lager
description: A light crisp lager with clean malt flavors

name: Coopers Original Pale Ale
description: A premium pale ale with traditional brewing techniques

name: 8Bit IPA
description: A full-tilt West Coast hit. Packed with citrus hops, floral aroma, and caramel malt for balance. Big bitterness, smooth finish. The perfect power-up for gamers chasing that next-level hoppy victory

name: Flight Path Pale Ale
description: Full flavoured, medium bodied and showcasing the best hops from Australia & New Zealand.  Fresh tropical notes sit on top of a biscuit and aromatic malt backdrop

name: SPLICER XPA
description: Using a blend of Galaxy, Ella and dry hopped Centennial. Couldn’t just settle for a straight up XPA, so we added grapefruit to the mix, creating true smashable refreshment.

name: Old Money
description: Notes of dark chocolate, roasted coffee, toffee, dried fruit, and spiced vanilla resulting from months of barrel-aging

name: Choc cherry porter
description: A smooth, indulgent porter layered with rich chocolate malt and subtle roasted depth. Bright cherry notes add a touch of sweetness and balance, while a hint of coconut brings a soft, creamy finish. Medium-bodied and approachable

name: Slow West - West Coast Pale
description: A touch of wheat with a tickle of munich, mashed with a high temp to give malt sweetness for the heavy hop rates. Whirlpool and DDH additions of Amarillo, Mosaic and CryoPOP garners pine, oranage zest, candied orange and tropical characters for a complexity belying the strength

name: Idiocracy - Hazy IPA
description: In the race to the bottom of cheap, adjunct laden lagers, the juxtaposition of fresh, hoppy beer has never been more acute. When just turning up sets you apart, we've loaded this Hazy with CryoPOP in a Coolpool, and Citra, Mosaic and Citra HyperBoost in an overloaded DDH. With extra calcium, sodium and chloride post ferment, it has what plants crave; electrolytes. These ions not only keep you hydrated, they leave the body full, giving a saline impression of softness, while also highlighting more subtle flavours. Just don't waste it on your ficus.

name: Bad Behaviour - NZ Pils
description: Troubled in its youth, Pilsner has returned to its roots, hops. A modern expression, with the classic. peppy finish. All the NZ heros are there, Motueka, Riwaka, Peacherine, Waimea and Manilita. Late kettle, WP and a DDH with some extra Peacharine HopKief for the finishing zhuzh. Fruit forward, with classic tropical, grapefruit, stonefruit and guava characters. The dry body brings drinkability, with a white pepper finish, leaving you wanting another

name: Tombstone - West Coast TIPA
description: A super lean base, fermented cold and dry, allowing the alcohol sweetness to be the balance. Bright citrus hops of Citra and Amarillo give a snappy and aromatic turn

name: Falling Down
description: Features rich, dark malt characteristics paired with a distinct smoky depth

name: Brewski Newstead Mill V Ruby Grapefruit Grisette
description: A twist on the traditional style, featuring heavy additions of ruby grapefruit to give it vibrant, zesty, and tart citrus fruit characteristics

name: Coastal Pale Ale
description: Like a dip in the surf, this coastal ale will refresh and revive you. With an undercurrent of summer fruits and just a splash of hoppy bitterness, this drop will go down as quickly as a stone in the ocean

name: Liquidambar Amber Ale
description: classic Amber Ale made with a solid grain backbone derived mainly from UK produced Maris Otter Malt that imparts a rich nutty flavour. The New World hops impart many classical flavours, with Magnum hops used for bittering and a mix of Crystal and Willamette hops giving flavour and aroma. Whilst pleasantly sessionable, allowing Liquidambar to warm gently in the glass will give great reward as flavours open up and intensify, showing its true complexity and depth of flavour

name: Twofold WCIPA
description: Hoppy, piney, and juicy with notes of grapefruit, resin, and a smooth, gutsy bitter finish

name: Buoyant XPA
description: With a citrus-heavy and tropical fruit aroma. Delivers a refreshing punch of hop bitterness without the heavy, filling malt profile of traditional pale ale
